engine.notes: Jacksonville has one dedicated improv theater, First Coast Comedy in Atlantic Beach, since Mad Cowford's sixteen-year run ended. The nearest multi-level school beyond it is Third Space Improv in St. Augustine; the city's other improv teaching sits inside acting studios. The Laugh Lounge downtown advertises improv classes but has no website of its own.

entries.name: First Coast Comedy
entries.summary: Jacksonville's only brick-and-mortar improv theater, with a bar, a rotating house cast, The Main Event on Fridays and Saturdays, a 21-plus Blue Show, and a three-course class track from Improv 101 to an advanced ensemble.
entries.schedule: Shows Fridays and Saturdays, 7:30pm all ages and 10pm 21+; multi-week classes ending in a showcase
signals: Only dedicated improv venue in Jacksonville
Three-course track from 101 to advanced ensemble
First Coast Comedy Festival, November 12 to 14, 2026
Owners with 20-plus years of improv experience
entries.reasons: The city's one improv theater with weekly shows, a venue of its own and a short class ladder, held back by an undated calendar and a programme that stops at three courses.

entries.name: Third Space Improv
entries.summary: A 50-seat studio in downtown St. Augustine with a six-level improv school, studio shows most Saturday nights mixing short-form games and long-form sets, and a monthly improv jam.
entries.schedule: Shows most Saturday nights; monthly improv jam; registration closes the day before each class starts
signals: Six class levels, Level 1 to design-your-own Level 6
entries.reasons: The deepest class ladder in northeast Florida and a weekly stage, but it is new, forty miles from Jacksonville, and its show calendar had no dates listed when checked.

entries.name: Creative Veins Performing Arts
entries.summary: A performing-arts studio two blocks from the Florida Theatre district offering acting, filmmaking and screenwriting courses, plus a four-hour Saturday Intro to Improv workshop for absolute beginners.
entries.schedule: Intro to Improv workshop on Saturdays 11am to 3pm; next dates November 14, 2026 and January 23, 2027
signals: Studio of its own at 1800 Atlantic Blvd
entries.reasons: A real studio with dated, bookable improv workshops, but improv is a single beginner day rather than a programme and there are no shows.

entries.name: BABS' LAB
entries.summary: Barbara Colaciello's storefront lab on King Street, where she teaches improvisation and story work through classes, workshops and coaching, and hosts a monthly Story Slam.
entries.schedule: Monthly Story Slam; class dates by enquiry
signals: Improv classes, workshops and one-to-one coaching
entries.reasons: A long-standing teacher with a room of her own and current events, but no published class schedule, levels or improv shows.

entries.name: Level Up Improv
entries.summary: Groundlings-trained teacher Christopher Schiavo's school for improv classes, camps and team-building across northeast Florida, with Level 1 and 2 courses aimed mainly at young students and a virtual option.
entries.schedule: Fall 2026 virtual Level 1, Tuesdays 4 to 5pm, September 22 to October 27
signals: Step Up for Students approved provider
entries.reasons: Dated classes from an experienced teacher, but no venue, no shows, and a programme pitched mostly at children.
